visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tantalizing close-up shot of several fully cooked, golden-brown chicken wings stacked neatly on a white ceramic plate. The wings are heavily glazed with a glossy, honey-like sauce and are meticulously garnished with thin, vibrant orange zest. The lighting is bright and warm, creating a welcoming and appetizing atmosphere that highlights the texture of the crispy skin and the translucent glaze. (2) A sharp transition shows a single raw chicken wing placed centrally on a clean, light-colored wooden cutting board. A person's hand, wearing a clear plastic protective glove, holds a silver chef's knife and carefully makes two deep, vertical cuts into the surface of the meat. The camera maintains a high-angle close-up perspective to emphasize the precision of the knife work against the pale, raw poultry skin. (3) The scene shifts to a large, clear glass bowl containing several raw chicken wings. In a series of rapid cuts, hands add various ingredients including clear white wine, white granulated sugar, fine salt, coarse black pepper, dried Italian herbs, minced white garlic, viscous amber honey, and freshly squeezed yellow orange juice. Each addition is shown clearly, with the ingredients layering over the raw meat in a vibrant palette of colors and textures. (4) The cook uses their gloved hands to thoroughly mix the chicken wings with the marinade, ensuring even coating. Following this, an orange is grated directly over the bowl, adding fresh, bright orange zest to the mixture. Liquid olive oil and a small bowl of white cornstarch are then added and incorporated into the thick, dark sauce until the wings are completely submerged in a rich, textured coating. (5) The marinated wings are individually arranged on a baking sheet lined with white parchment paper. A thin, semi-circular slice of fresh orange is placed delicately on top of each wing as a functional garnish. The scene then moves to the interior of a dark oven where the wings are seen roasting under a warm orange glow, with the skin visibly sizzling and the glaze bubbling as they cook through the glass door.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring a steady drum beat and synth melodies. A male narrator introduces the dish with a friendly, enthusiastic, and professional tone. The acoustic quality is studio-clean with a balanced frequency spectrum and no background noise. (2) A distinct 'click' sound effect marks a transition. The narrator explains the chicken wing cutting technique with a fast speech rate. The BGM remains consistent in the background, maintaining an energetic and positive mood throughout the brief instructional sequence. (3) Soft metallic clinking and light thud sounds occur as various ingredients are added to the bowl. The narrator lists the spices and sauces with clear articulation and a rising intonation pattern to keep the audience engaged while the music continues at its original tempo. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound effect triggers a new phase as the mixing process begins. The narrator provides tips on marination timing. The BGM's percussive elements are more noticeable here, creating a rhythmic synergy with the narration's fast-paced delivery style. (5) A mechanical latch sound is heard as the oven door closes. The narrator specifies the baking temperature and duration with high vocal arousal. The background music swells slightly during this segment, adding to the sense of progression and impending completion of the recipe. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's warm closing remarks and a final 'pop' sound effect. The BGM fades out gradually, maintaining a major-key tonality that leaves a positive and satisfying impression of the completed culinary tutorial.
